body:
We need to automatically scale GitHub Actions Runners inside Minikube, pair Minikube with GitHub’s official [Actions Runner Controller (ARC)](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/tutorials/use-actions-runner-controller/get-started) installed via Helm.

Also with Ansible and Terraform configuration for contabo, so we can even scale not only in per job level, but also per machine level.

Recommented machine configuration is 6 CPU, 12 GB RAM, and 200 GB SSD in contabo (best value we found).

We also need to support similar priced VPS providers, so similar to $7.20 per mouth or cheaper.

The goal is to make the most easy to scale and flexible solution for easy to deploy and manage.

We should have CLI, library for all operations including deploy, reconfiguration and so on.

Our tool should be able to add our configuration to ansible/terraform, or even add them from scratch. We should be able to use our tool in CI/CD for deployment and our development machine for easy and fast reconfiguration (making changes to repository, so we just need to merge pull request (our tool should be able to prepare pull request with description with all changes automatically).

We also need to support API of contabo and similar providers, which provide good value for the cause.

And result - hastle free private self hosted CI/CD runners, which are flixible inside each machine, and easy to configure number of machines with CI/CD flexible runners.

We also should be able to run our system in docker/helm, so we can monitor the resources use, and use API of hosting providers to scale up and down.

We also need to have docker/helm charts for complete SaaS solution, where user can buy GitHub Actions Runners on demand with payment of per execution time with configurable price, so we can provide easy to plugin solution.

Also our CLI tool in addition to deploy, reconfiguration should support configuration directly on GitHub for organization and repository wide runners configuration.

Think of all combinations and edge cases. We also should have nice landing page.

Automatically generated docs and so on.

If something is missing yet usually found in similar services - do it all.

So we should support fully self hosted SaaS (with only the core features, and even with ability to resell spare resources when not used).

We should also be able to automatically connect multiple such systems together, so on sales point can actually buy from others to resell seemlessly. So we can have single sales point, and connect all others to it.

So we can have any configurations of this system.

From just using self hosted solution to make it easy, to do sales of spare resources, or to be hub/marketplace for multiple providers.

So we maximize resource utilization that way.

It also should be secure and so on.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Initial full implementation
